## Use Droid Sans Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Droid Sans Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Droid Sans Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Droid Sans Mono coding font

The default monospace font for Android. Droid Sans Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Droid Sans Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Droid Sans Mono FAQ

### Is Droid Sans Mono free?

Yes. Droid Sans Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Droid Sans Mono support ligatures?

No. Droid Sans Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Droid Sans Mono?

Droid Sans Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
